messages.content: my sister has gone to the market. can i know she is back home?
not from that sentence. has gone to the market usually gives the idea that she went there and is not back yet.
what if i want to say she went there and returned?
you can say: my sister went to the market and came back. that makes the return clear.
can has been to the market work too?
yes. my sister has been to the market can be used to say she visited it and returned, though context is useful.
now make a message saying she is home with the food.
my sister is home with the food after going to the market.
why did you add food?
you asked for a message with the food, so i added that detail to the example. the sentence about the market did not give it by itself.
if i only say she is home, can you know what she bought?
no. being home does not tell me what she bought or whether she bought anything.
only give the sentence with gone again.
my sister has gone to the market.
now only the clear sentence about returning.
my sister went to the market and came back.
my aunt said my cousin is visiting her. i want to ask how the visit is going, not ask to join them.
you could say: how is the visit going? i hope you enjoy the time together.
can you keep out hope because i only want a question?
how is the visit going?
what if i ask when are you having dinner? could that sound like i want to come?
it could sound like you want to join dinner. how is the visit going keeps the question about their time together.
make that explanation shorter.
asking about dinner may sound like you want to join. asking how the visit is going is more general.
now ask whether they have been to the park, without saying i want to go.
have you been to the park together?
can that mean today or the whole visit?
it could mean either if the time is not clear. add today or during the visit if you need a specific time.
ask just about today.
have you been to the park together today?
only give the first question again.
how is the visit going?
write a story about a child saying a drawing is finished. the parent should ask what she wants from this picture.

a child put down her drawing and said it was finished. her father saw an empty part of the page and asked whether she wanted to add anything there. she said no. the picture was of a tree in a large garden, and she wanted space around it. he had thought finished would mean the whole page was full. she explained that she had made the thing she wanted to show. he looked again and saw how the empty part made the tree easy to see. they put the page on the wall without adding anything else.
why did the father ask about the empty part?
he thought there might still be work to do there. he had not yet understood the child wanted that space.
did the child need a full page to finish her own picture?
no. in the story, her goal was to show the tree with space around it. making the page full was not the task she had chosen.
what could he ask before saying more work is needed?
is the empty space part of what you want the picture to show?
answer in the child voice.
yes. i want the tree to have room around it.
can you finish with him asking where she wants to put it?
he asked where she would like the picture to go. she chose a place on the wall where she could see it from the table.
what changed in his understanding?
he learned that the picture could be finished when it did what she wanted. every part of the page did not need a drawing.
a friend asked why i am busy tomorrow. i do not want to explain the whole day. can i answer without all the details?
yes. you can say: i have some things to do tomorrow and cannot make a plan for that day.
i do want to make a plan for the evening, just not the morning.
then be specific about that part. i am busy tomorrow morning, but i may be free in the evening.
can i say i will be free if i have not checked yet?
it is better to say may be free until you know. that leaves the evening open without giving a sure answer.
write a reply that says i will check.
i am busy tomorrow morning. i will check whether i am free in the evening and let you know.
why not make up a simple reason for being busy?
you do not need a made up reason to keep details to yourself. you can give the information needed for the plan without telling everything else.
what if they ask again?
you can say it again in a kind way: i do not want to explain the details, but i will let you know about the evening.
only give the message without an explanation.
you can say: i do not want to explain the details, but i will let you know about the evening.
only give the first reply about what i need to check.
i am busy tomorrow morning. i will check whether i am free in the evening and let you know.
my brother read two stories this morning. i read the same two after lunch. how many different stories did we read?
you read two different stories between you, because you both read the same two.
how many stories did each person read?
your brother read two, and you read two.
if i add what each person read, is that four?
yes. adding two for your brother and two for you gives four. that is not the same as saying there were four different stories.
now i read another story that he has not read.
then you have read three, your brother has read two, and there are three different stories between you.
if he reads that new one later, how many different stories are there?
still three. he would be reading a story already in the group, so it does not add a different one.
how many would we each have read then?
you would each have read three stories.
can you know how long that took?
no. you gave the number of stories, not the time each person spent reading.
only give the number of different stories at the end.
three.
i tried cooking something new today. i was slow, but i understood more by the end.
learning a new meal can take time. what did you understand at the end that was not clear at the start?
i knew which things to have ready before starting. i had to stop again and again to look for them.
that is useful information for next time. you can have those things ready first, even if the rest still takes time.
i do not want to say i should be fast already.
you do not have to turn one try into a rule about being fast. you can think about what you learned without saying you must be fast now.
can you put that into one sentence in my voice?
i was slow today, but i learned what to have ready before i begin next time.
what if the next try is slow too?
then you can look at what still needs time. having one thing ready may help, but the whole meal can still take time.
give that in one short sentence.
you can have one thing ready and still need time for the rest.
now just give a kind reply without another plan.
you learned something useful today, even while working slowly.
write a story about a child drawing a window and another child asking why it does not open. they should enjoy the idea while keeping the facts clear.

a child drew a window on a page and put the page on the wall. her brother came in and asked why the new window did not open. she said that it was a picture, so the paper would not let air into the room. he asked whether the sky in the drawing was the real sky too. she showed him the real window. the sky outside had changed while the drawing stayed the same. then they drew a cloud on another page and made up a story about a room with paper weather. they could play with the idea while still knowing which window was real.
why did the drawing not let air in?
it was a picture on paper, not an opening in the wall.
what stayed the same when the sky outside changed?
the sky in the drawing stayed the same.
can a picture still be useful if it is not the real thing?
yes. it can show an idea, help someone remember a place, or be part of a story. it does not need to be the real object to have a use.
write the reply in the voice of the child who drew it.
this is a picture of a window. it can show the sky i drew, but it cannot open like the real window.
what made their game different from a wrong fact about the room?
they knew they were making up a story about paper weather. they were not saying the drawing really changed the air.
finish with both pictures on the wall.
they put the cloud picture next to the window picture, then opened the real window to feel the air.
is this is my correct by itself?
if you are saying the thing is yours, use this is mine. my usually needs a word after it, such as my book.
give both correct sentences about a book.
this is my book. this book is mine.
what if it is the book of my sister?
you can say: this book is hers. or: this is the book of my sister.
now make it a book my sister and i share.
this is a book my sister and i share.
can you use our with book?
yes. you can say this is our book.
why not just this is our?
our usually needs a word after it. this is our book is a full sentence. this is our leaves out the thing you mean.
what if we only share the room and the book is mine?
then give both details: we share the room, but this book is mine.
only give that sentence.
we share the room, but this book is mine.
